name: Desirea Kennedy 515 SW Century Dr

nadir.desc: The property includes a long, rectangular multi-storied building|There is a paved parking area to the northwest of the building and on the southern edge of the building|A major road with a traffic circle is located to the northeast of the property, and a paved access road runs along the western edge of the building|A detached building is observable to the south of the main building, along with a large parking lot|Another road from the traffic circle runs along the northern perimeter of the property.

alpha.desc: The front of the multi-storied building includes a main entrance in the middle and a large sidewalk running the entire length of the building|Windows are lined along the front facade on each floor|A major street runs the length of the front of the building|An empty lot is visible behind the building, and an additional property with large trees is located across the street in front of the building.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the different floors of the building, complete with evenly spaced windows|A small parking area is visible on the side, along with portions of a detached structure|The access road that runs along the west of the building is also visible.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows multiple floors with windows and small balconies evenly spaced along each floor|A small parking area is located to the left of the rear of the building|An empty lot is visible to the west of the building.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the multi-leveled building with a small paved parking area to the right of the building|A traffic circle and two intersecting streets are visible to the left|Large trees can be seen across the street from the property.

considerations: Access to the property is available at the two parking lots, with a street running along the eastern side and another running along the northern side of the property. Both parking lots are small. The property is dominated by the building with little to no vegetation. Large trees on all sides of the property could block visibility of the building from afar. The traffic circle to the northeast provides circulation options for approaching vehicles.
